question: Should a pending Skill Workshop approval prompt become invalid whenever its proposal is revised, requiring the operator to review and approve the current version?
rationale: This is a deliberate operator-workflow and compatibility contract. The contributor and an operator support it, but the discussion expressly says upstream maintainer endorsement is still required.

options.title: Accept fail-closed review binding
options.body: Require a fresh review and approval after every proposal revision so approval cannot apply content the operator did not inspect.

options.title: Preserve prompt validity after revisions
options.body: Allow a previously displayed approval to act on revised proposal content, retaining convenience but weakening the reviewed-snapshot guarantee.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed review binding
recommendation.body: Require a fresh review and approval after every proposal revision so approval cannot apply content the operator did not inspect.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining question is product acceptance of the operator approval contract, and the supplied timeline explicitly routed the PR to this participant.
